text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion and I are in Hokkaido for
the
Sapporo Kinen. We're surrounded by
reporters
almost as soon as we arrive.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion! How are you feeling in the
lead-up
to the race?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I have no complaints. More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm very excited to be able to run
against Air
Groove! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right. The skilled runner who has
entered
the Sapporo Kinen is none other
than Fine
Motion's roommate, Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We even traveled here together today,
but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Geez... It's only too easy guess where
you'll be.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Groove! You're going to make me
blush
saying things like that in front of
all these
people! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm saying that you always cause a
ruckus! Stop
taking everything as a
compliment!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're already going at it! Air
Groove,
what are your thoughts on your
showdown with
Fine Motion?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I'm well aware of her ability.
I'll admit
that I didn't expect to run
against her, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You could say that I had been hoping it
would
happen.
I do hope you're
planning on making it
interesting, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
Y-yes! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... There you have it. It seems like
we should
have quite a race in store for
everyone. Please
look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
We can't wait!
Good luck to the both of
you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I really want to leave Groove
gobsmacked...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion begins muttering strange
things to
herself right before the race...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She has such high expectations for me. I
want to
make it interesting for her with a
surprise!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's fine if that's not how she meant it.
This is what
I want to do!
choice_data_list: そういう意味じゃないと思うけど……

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm up against Groove! It would be
insulting if I
just ran normally.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For example, I could hang behind and
buuuuild
up my power, until...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Whoosh! I blast on by her right at the end! That'd shock her, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, an "end closer"
strategy... If Fine
Motion's current form
is up to it, it might be a
strategy worth
considering.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the final decision up to you. ♪
After all,
even if I run normally...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten so good it's shocking in its
own right,
isn't it? ♪
